data.title: Beta Test II Has Officially Ended
data.brief: Dear Endministrator,Arknights: Endfield Beta Test II has officially ended. The server has been shut
data.data:
Dear Endministrator,

Arknights: Endfield Beta Test II has officially ended. The server has been shut down, and you can no longer log in. All data from this test will be deleted. We sincerely thank all of you for following and participating in this test.


For more updates, please follow our official community. Thank you again for your continued interest and support for Arknights: Endfield, Endministrator!
